blocks.text:
# Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}# Machine merge bot stub — event-driven fast path (factory pack).
#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. # Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}# Machine merge bot stub — event-driven fast path (factory pack).
#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}# Machine merge bot stub — event-driven fast path (factory pack).
#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}# Machine merge bot stub — event-driven fast path (factory pack).
#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

# Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.

#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

## Automated Code Review — APPROVE

**Summary**: The change is contract-safe and verified end-to-end: `factory-sm.yml` and `factory-merge.yml` @main both declare `APP_ID`/`APP_PRIVATE_KEY` as optional secrets (fetched live), the repo has both secrets configured (created 2026-10-17T13:11Z, before this PR), and `factory_stub_ref_test.dart` does not pin an exact secrets set, so no test breaks. Scope matches the ticket (SM + merge stubs only).

**Key Issues**:
- ⚠️ The remediation is incomplete: `ai-teammate.yml` (the third explicit-secret stub) was not updated, yet `factory-teammate.yml` @main declares the same optional `APP_ID`/`APP_PRIVATE_KEY` and its own docs name the ai-teammate PAT exhaustion (dmtools-agents run 39034080472 — the exact incident cited in this PR) as what killed the SM ticks. Teammate legs keep riding the rate-limited shared PAT.
- ⚠️ `machine-sm.yml:93-95` still reads "EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only)" — now false, and this file's comments are load-bearing runbooks.
- 💡 `machine-sm.yml` still lacks a trailing newline (pre-existing, carried through the touched line).

**Next Steps**:
1. Merge this, then follow up by mapping `APP_ID`/`APP_PRIVATE_KEY` in `ai-teammate.yml` so the incident's primary PAT consumer moves to App auth too.
2. Update the "EXACTLY the set (SOURCE only)" comment in `machine-sm.yml` to name the current three-secret set.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Incident remediation is incomplete — the teammate stub still rides the rate-limited PAT**

This PR moves the SM and merge stubs onto App installation tokens, but the third explicit-secret stub, `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml`, was left unmapped — it still passes only `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` / `ZAI_CODE_KEY` / `KIMI_REVIEW_KEY` to `factory-teammate.yml`.

That matters because the incident this PR cites was teammate-driven: `factory-teammate.yml` @main declares the same optional `APP_ID` / `APP_PRIVATE_KEY` secrets (awf#52) and its secret description states verbatim that "the ai-teammate PAT exhausted its 500 req/h and killed SM ticks (dmtools-agents run 39034080472)" — the exact run cited in the PR description. Verified live:

```yaml
# factory-teammate.yml @main (secrets block)
APP_ID:
  description: 'Optional GitHub App id (awf#52). With APP_PRIVATE_KEY set, every
    GitHub API call and git push in the leg rides a per-job App installation
    token ... instead of SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN. Absent => PAT, byte-identical
    to the pre-App behavior.'
  required: false
```

After this PR, SM ticks and the merge bot survive on minted tokens, but teammate legs keep burning the same shared `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT — the consumer the factory documentation identifies as the rate-limit hog. The fix heals two of three callers and leaves the root offender in place.

Scope note: the ticket does say "One-block change in machine-sm.yml + machine-merge.yml", so this doesn't block this PR — but please either (a) follow up immediately with the identical two-line block in `ai-teammate.yml`, or (b) say explicitly in the PR/ticket why the teammate legs must stay on the PAT.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Stale "EXACTLY the set (SOURCE only)" comment now contradicts the block**

The comment directly above this line (lines 93-95) still reads:

```yaml
# EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
# secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
# (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
```

That is no longer true: the block now maps three secrets (`SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` + `APP_ID` + `APP_PRIVATE_KEY`). I verified `factory-sm.yml` @main does declare both `APP_*` secrets as optional, so the change itself is safe — but the comment is now a false runbook. These comment blocks in the machine stubs are demonstrably load-bearing (they record live bisect results like the probe H2/I failures that bit a previous PR), and a future reader applying "EXACTLY the set the factory declares (SOURCE only)" as a rule would strip the two lines this PR just added, reverting the fix.

Suggest rewriting to something like:

```yaml
# The set factory-sm.yml declares: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required) +
# APP_ID / APP_PRIVATE_KEY (optional, awf#52 App auth) — mapping a
# secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
# (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
```

Also note line 89's "(plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY)" parenthetical refers to the *teammate* factory's declaration, not factory-sm's — worth disambiguating while you're in here.

💡 **SUGGESTION: Missing trailing newline at EOF (pre-existing, now carried through a touched line)**

`machine-sm.yml` ends without a `\n` (`\ No newline at end of file` in the diff). This predates the PR, but since the last line is being edited anyway, adding the newline removes a perpetual diff-noise marker. `machine-merge.yml` ends cleanly, so only this file needs it.

blocks.text:
# Machine SM — thin stub over the dmtools-agents factory (reusable pack).
#
# The whole reconcile tick (engine checkout, dmtools install, rule run)
# lives in IstiN/dmtools-agents/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml. This
# file carries only the triggers (cron + manual dry dispatch) and the
# call. NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm`
# group — a caller declaring the same group deadlocks the called workflow
# (it waits forever on a group its own caller holds).

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true


# The factory's own permissions block cannot raise rights above the
# caller, and the org default caps the token at read-only — the silent
# update-branch path (workflow token, updatePullRequestBranch) failed
# live with "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update
# this pull request" until this explicit block lifted the ceiling.
permissions:
  # contents: write — update-branch pushes a merge commit onto the PR head
  # branch; PullRequests: write alone is denied at the refs level (live:
  # "github-actions[bot] does not have permission to update this pull
  # request" even with PullRequests: write granted).
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps (factory #510):
                          # the reusable factory requests it — the caller
                          # must grant an equal-or-superset or the workflow
                          # dies with startup_failure (live 16:03-16:13 ×3).
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): awf main is load-bearing and review-gated, so
    # pack fixes go live on merge with no re-pin ceremony (recently
    # shipped on main: #579 conflict-rework, #577/#578
    # mutexExcludeSelf-by-fact-of-holding, #576 review-machine-unlinked,
    # #573-#574 pack snapshots + registry env, #572 review-stale-verdict,
    # #571 dmtools self-heal, #570 SM budget 1→3, #569 rework fatality,
    # #568 mergeBot workspace/repository args, #566 pack-registry runner
    # overrides). Accepted trade-off: a mutable ref executes whatever
    # sits at the awf main head at run start. The ENGINE (dmtools-agents)
    # resolves from releases via vars — no factory_ref here. Flip in
    # lockstep with the other machine-loop stubs — guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # #687: one source of truth for the machine login (repo variable).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      # #687: the workflow token — silent branch updates (pushes trigger
      # no workflows). Input channel: secrets-block mapping arrives empty.
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # Dispatch-only CI: this repo's CI file (the SM dispatches it on PR
      # heads; default 'quality.yml' fits dmtools-dart, not this repo).
      # gh-1537: the dispatched run is the SINGLE pre-merge gate — ci.yml
      # no longer fires on push:main (post-merge main CI retired), so the
      # validation dispatch must cover every whole-tree gate (crap4dart
      # baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd, app-crap-gate — all full-gate on
      # non-PR events). The serialized-validation invariant (#687) is
      # alarmed repo-side by sm-merge-guard.yml: a main push whose tree no
      # successful dispatch covered files an sm-guard issue.
      ci-workflow: ci.yml
      # Bridge-free mode (factory #510): the tick stamps the three required
      # protection checks itself — ci-gate.yml bridge is deleted in this PR.
      validation-checks: '["Quality gate","JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)","Binaries smoke gate"]'
      # Factory-state snapshot → public prerelease asset (board: site/factory)
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"fa-state.json"}'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect: inherit => startup failure, explicit => green).
    secrets:
      # EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
      # secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
      # (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
      # NOTE: github.token CANNOT ride this block — GitHub delivers an
      # empty value when it is mapped through a reusable call's secrets
      # (live-verified); it rides the silent-token INPUT below instead.
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}# Machine merge bot stub — event-driven fast path (factory pack).
#
# The SM cron tick is best-effort (GitHub silently drops scheduled runs);
# this workflow reacts to EVENTS: CI conclusion, label changes, head
# pushes, check-run completions — and runs the deterministic mergeBot
# (factory-merge.yml) so approved green PRs merge within seconds.
# Idempotent against the SM: shared labels, first actor wins.
name: 'Machine Merge Bot'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI', 'Quality']   # per-repo: fa's dispatched CI is named 'CI'
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, edited]
  check_run:
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: machine-merge-bot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  merge:
    # Label events only matter for the machine latches; other PR events
    # (synchronize/edited) always run — cheap and idempotent.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      github.event.action != 'labeled' ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'ai_') ||
      contains(github.event.label.name, 'pr_approved')
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge.yml@main
    with:
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

# Merge Trigger — thin stub over the canonical pr_approved merge bot.
# All logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-merge-trigger.yml; the event triggers stay repo-side.
# fa passes narrower linking inputs (no PR-label mapping / gh-N pattern)
# and no PR-label removal to reproduce the historical behavior exactly.
name: Merge Trigger

run-name: 'Merge Trigger : CI passed → merge pr_approved issues'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  merge-trigger:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04), guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart. The callee declares NO
    # secrets and documents `secrets: inherit` as the PAT passthrough
    # (GH_TOKEN falls back to github.token inside) — unlike
    # teammate/sm/merge, whose factories DECLARE SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN
    # required and reject inherit at call time.
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-merge-trigger.yml@main
    with:
      runner: ubuntu-latest
      remove_pr_label: false
      map_pr_labels: true
      gh_branch_pattern: false
    secrets: inherit
====
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
====
      pr: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr || '' }}
      # #687: machine login via jobParams — branch-independent (the
      # checked-out PR branch carries no machineAuthor config).
      machine-author: ${{ vars.MACHINE_AUTHOR || '' }}
      leg: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.leg || github.event.inputs.leg || '' }}
      reason: ${{ github.event.inputs.reason || 'ai-teammate-author gate' }}
      # 2026-10-17 incident: ubuntu-slim force-cancels teammate jobs at
      # ~15m20-52s (5 cancelled legs tonight; agents repo: 6/6 at ~15m24s).
      # Legs under ~13 min survive — that's why short fa legs looked fine.
      # Owner decision: ai-teammate legs pin ubuntu-latest; CI stays slim.
      runner: 'ubuntu-latest'
    # Explicit mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
    # required named secret (plus optional ZAI_CODE_KEY / KIMI_REVIEW_KEY),
    # and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy required-secret validation at
    # call time (live bisect on dmtools-dart: inherit => startup failure).
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ZAI_CODE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ZAI_CODE_KEY }}
      KIMI_REVIEW_KEY: ${{ secrets.KIMI_REVIEW_KEY }}

  dmtools <tool> --file params.json     # Execute with JSON file
  dmtools <tool> --verbose              # Execute with verbose output
  dmtools <tool> --debug                # Execute with debug output and error messages
  dmtools <tool> <<EOF                  # Execute with heredoc

Examples:
  dmtools list
  dmtools doctor
  dmtools run job-config.json
  dmtools run codegenerator --param1 test

```yaml
# factory-teammate.yml @main (secrets block)
APP_ID:
  description: 'Optional GitHub App id (awf#52). With APP_PRIVATE_KEY set, every
    GitHub API call and git push in the leg rides a per-job App installation
    token ... instead of SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN. Absent => PAT, byte-identical
    to the pre-App behavior.'
  required: false
```

After this PR, SM ticks and the merge bot survive on minted tokens, but teammate legs keep burning the same shared `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT — the consumer the factory documentation identifies as the rate-limit hog. The fix heals two of three callers and leaves the root offender in place.

{"path":"outputs/pr_review_comments/comment2.md","content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Stale "EXACTLY the set (SOURCE only)" comment now contradicts the block**

The comment directly above this line (lines 93-95) still reads:

```yaml
# EXACTLY the set factory-sm.yml declares (SOURCE only) — mapping a
# secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time
# (probe H2: +ZAI/KIMI => startup failure; probe I: exact set => green).
```

That is no longer true: the block now maps three secrets (`SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` + `APP_ID` + `APP_PRIVATE_KEY`). I verified `factory-sm.yml` @main does declare both `APP_*` secrets as optional, so the change itself is safe — but the comment is now a false runbook. These comment blocks in the machine stubs are demonstrably load-bearing (they record live bisect results like the probe H2/I failures that bit a previous PR), and a future reader applying "EXACTLY the set the factory declares (SOURCE only)" as a rule would strip the two lines this PR just added, reverting the fix.

Suggest rewriting to something like:

```yaml
# The set factory-sm.yml declares: SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required) +
# APP_ID / APP_PRIVATE_KEY (optional, awf#52 App auth) — mapping a
# secret the callee does not declare is rejected at call time

```
